diff --git a/src/ahttpx/_parsers.py b/src/ahttpx/_parsers.py
index 8a52a56..484f428 100644
--- a/src/ahttpx/_parsers.py
+++ b/src/ahttpx/_parsers.py
@@ -375,7 +375,11 @@ class HTTPParser:
             self.recv_state = State.DONE
         return body
 
-    async def complete(self):
+    @property
+    def keep_alive(self) -> bool:
+        return self.send_keep_alive and self.recv_keep_alive
+
+    async def reset(self):
         is_fully_complete = self.send_state == State.DONE and self.recv_state == State.DONE
         is_keepalive = self.send_keep_alive and self.recv_keep_alive
 
diff --git a/src/ahttpx/_pool.py b/src/ahttpx/_pool.py
index f712cfa..4303f98 100644
--- a/src/ahttpx/_pool.py
+++ b/src/ahttpx/_pool.py
@@ -237,7 +237,7 @@ class Connection(Transport):
 
     # Request/response cycle complete...
     async def _complete(self) -> None:
-        await self._parser.complete()
+        await self._parser.reset()
         self._idle_expiry = time.monotonic() + self._keepalive_duration
 
     async def _close(self) -> None:
diff --git a/src/ahttpx/_server.py b/src/ahttpx/_server.py
index a9103cc..c804d18 100644
--- a/src/ahttpx/_server.py
+++ b/src/ahttpx/_server.py
@@ -89,7 +89,10 @@ class HTTPConnection:
 
     # Start it all over again...
     async def _complete(self):
-        await self._parser.complete
+        # Drain any remaining request body before resetting.
+        while await self._parser.recv_body():
+            pass
+        await self._parser.reset()
         self._idle_expiry = time.monotonic() + self._keepalive_duration
 
 
@@ -104,8 +107,11 @@ class HTTPServer:
 
 @contextlib.asynccontextmanager
 async def serve_http(endpoint):
+    connections = []
+
     async def handler(stream):
         connection = HTTPConnection(stream, endpoint)
+        connections.append(connection)
         await connection.handle_requests()
 
     logging.basicConfig(
@@ -115,12 +121,19 @@ async def serve_http(endpoint):
     )
 
     backend = NetworkBackend()
-    async with await backend.serve("127.0.0.1", 8080, handler) as server:
-        server = HTTPServer(server.host, server.port)
-        logger.info(f"Serving on {server.url} (Press CTRL+C to quit)")
-        yield server
+    try:
+        async with await backend.serve("127.0.0.1", 8080, handler) as server:
+            server = HTTPServer(server.host, server.port)
+            logger.info(f"Serving on {server.url} (Press CTRL+C to quit)")
+            yield server
+    finally:
+        for connection in connections:
+            await connection.close()
 
 
 async def run(app):
-    async with await serve_http(app) as server:
-        server.wait()
+    try:
+        async with await serve_http(app) as server:
+            await server.wait()
+    except KeyboardInterrupt:
+        pass
